name: funding-signal-play
description: Runs trigger-based outbound when a target account raises funding: signal stacking to cut false positives, use-of-funds messaging, a 48-hour first-touch bar, a 14-day 5-touch sequence, and benchmark-anchored measurement. Use when the user wants to reach recently funded companies or set up funding alerts. Triggers on: "funding signal", "funding play", "raised money outreach", "funding announcement outbound", "Series A/B/C prospecting".
